title: allow read-only git grep for reviewer roles, or say in the brief that Grep is the way to search

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-183723-3908, project ork, item S521:

allow read-only git grep for reviewer roles, or say in the brief that Grep is the way to search

Evidence: git -C WORKTREE grep -n "CheckReport(" -- internal was denied, but the brief only says git grep is not on the read-only list for base reads
